title: Hopper FP8: stability hardening and calibration reconciler service
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a lightweight calibration reconciler service and runtime hardening changes to safely enable FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) on Hopper. This ticket covers: per-layer scale annealing, hysteresis-based autoswitch heuristics, kernel fallback mechanics to INT8 for edge cases, expanded golden-seed evals, telemetry gating for canary rollouts, and an automated reconciliation loop that repairs calibration drift detected in production. Goal: unblock staged enablement for selected models with measured <1% regression on our eval suite and no increased crash-rate in canary clusters.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Calibration reconciler deployed in canary cluster and reconciles drifting profiles within 30 minutes. 2) Golden-seed regression <1% for top-20 customer models. 3) No increase in OOM or kernel-failure events above baseline during 2 week canary. 4) Runtime fallback to INT8 triggers automatically under defined thresholds and records events in Alerting dashboard.
implementation_notes:
- Add reconciler microservice that consumes per-model profile snapshots and recent inference histograms, computes drift scores, and submits calibrated profile diffs to the runtime.
- Integrate reconciler with central KVS and add optimistic locks to avoid conflicting updates.
- Per-layer scale annealing: implement a short annealing window post-activation to smooth per-op scales and avoid spike quantization noise.
- Hysteresis autoswitch: require sustained metric deviation (5 minutes) before switching E4M3<->E5M2, with cool-down of 15 minutes.
- Kernel fallback: detect per-batch numeric anomalies (nan/inf/gradients) and route subsequent requests for that model to INT8-compatible kernel path for 10 minutes.
- Expose reconciler actions in Console with audit log and ability to pin/rollback profiles.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: reconciler could apply aggressive adjustments that regress quality. Mitigation: reconciler runs in shadow mode for one week; all diffs are simulated against golden-seed before commit. Risk: additional latency from reconciler checks. Mitigation: reconciler runs asynchronously; runtime keeps prior profile until new one validated by shadow evals. Risk: telemetry blind spots for tail workloads. Mitigation: add sampled prefix capture and store lightweight KV histograms for long-tail sequences.
test_plan:
- Create golden-seed set (10k prompts across categories) and baseline FP32/INT8/FP8 scores.
- Automated smoke: run reconciler in staging that produces diffs; validate on golden-seed and on-perf harness.
- Stress: inject synthetic sequence-length spikes and run canary for 48h to observe fallback behavior.
- Safety: run OOM/kernel-fault fuzzing harness with E4M3/E5M2 selection enabled.
- Telemetry: add dashboards for drift-rate, reconciler actions/sec, fallback-counts, and per-model regression metric.
